# Daily Briefing – Sunday 22 November

Yesterday was a solid rest day, Liam. No structured training but 9,753 steps kept you nicely active, and burning 2,514 kcal against a 2,300 target gives you good metabolic momentum. Sleep at 7.2 hours is decent, though nudging closer to 8 would sharpen everything.

The one flag worth noting is your HRV at 74ms, sitting below your 89-119ms baseline. Your resting HR of 54 bpm looks healthy, and stress at 36/100 is reassuringly low, so this likely reflects accumulated fatigue rather than anything acute. Keep today moderate — a easy aerobic run or light movement rather than anything intense.

With HRV suppressed, prioritise recovery nutrition today. Hit your 175g protein target and add some anti-inflammatory foods — oily fish, berries, or leafy greens. Hydration often gets overlooked on rest days, so aim for 2.5-3 litres. You're building something good here. 💪
